summary: Atkore Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a settlement agreement with the End User Plaintiff class in the In re PVC Pipe Antitrust Litigation. The Company agreed to pay $50 million into a settlement fund, subject to court approval. Payment is due ~21 days after preliminary approval. The settlement covers all antitrust claims and includes fees and administration costs; it will be a non-operating expense in the June 2026 quarter and funded from cash on hand. No admission of liability. This is a litigation settlement, not a special situation transaction.
